product.title: Joshua Tree Open Air Hummer Adventure

description.text:
Experience Joshua Tree National Park from the open air aboard a custom touring Hummer designed specifically for desert exploration. Travel through dramatic rock formations, ancient Joshua Tree forests, rugged desert valleys, and panoramic Mojave landscapes while enjoying unobstructed views and informative narration from your guide throughout the journey.

With convenient departures available from Palm Desert, downtown Palm Springs, and Yucca Valley, this small-group adventure offers one of the most immersive and accessible ways to explore Joshua Tree National Park from the Greater Palm Springs area. Along the route, guides share fascinating insights into the geology, wildlife, ecology, and cultural history that make Joshua Tree one of California’s most remarkable national parks.

Guests consistently describe the experience as a highlight of their Palm Springs vacation thanks to the combination of fresh desert air, scenic photo stops, entertaining storytelling, and the unique perspective provided by the elevated open-air Hummer design. The custom vehicles feature forward-facing seating, shade canopies, and panoramic visibility that allow travelers to fully experience the desert landscape rather than viewing it through the windows of a traditional bus tour.

highlights: Ride through Joshua Tree National Park in an open-air Hummer.
See dramatic rock formations and desert landscapes with guide commentary.
Stop at scenic viewpoints for photos and interpretation.
Small-group format for a more personal experience.

start.description: Multiple pickup and departure options are available from the Greater Palm Springs area, including Palm Desert, Palm Springs, and Yucca Valley.

itineraryItems.title: Joshua Tree National Park
itineraryItems.description: Begin the adventure with travel into Joshua Tree National Park aboard an open-air Hummer, with guided narration and scenic desert views along the way.

itineraryItems.title: Keys View
itineraryItems.description: Stop at one of the park’s most famous overlooks, where clear days can reveal views across the Coachella Valley, the Salton Sea, and toward Mexico.

itineraryItems.title: Barker Dam Trail
itineraryItems.description: Enjoy an optional walk through a classic Joshua Tree landscape featuring monzogranite rock formations, desert plants, and historic desert scenery.

itineraryItems.title: Cap Rock Trail
itineraryItems.description: Visit one of Joshua Tree’s most photographed rock formation areas, with a short optional walk among dramatic boulders and desert terrain.

exclusions: Hotel pickup and drop-off unless selected
additionalInfo: Children must be accompanied by an adult.
Operates in most weather conditions; dress appropriately.
Cancellation policy: cancel at least 48 hours in advance for a full refund.

faqs.question: Where does the tour depart from?
faqs.answer: Multiple pickup and departure options are available from the Greater Palm Springs area, including Palm Desert, Palm Springs, and Yucca Valley.

faqs.question: How long is the experience?
faqs.answer: The Hummer adventure is approximately 3 to 5 hours.

faqs.question: What is included?
faqs.answer: Your booking includes a professional guide, open-air Hummer transportation, and bottled water.

faqs.question: Is the tour suitable for all travelers?
faqs.answer: Most travelers can participate, but the tour is not wheelchair accessible.
